overview: The Planar Observatory Tower is Shar Vahl’s arcane watchtower, used to monitor celestial alignments and planar anomalies.
history: The tower was constructed to observe Luclin’s sky and its planar disturbances.
Arcane telescopes were added to track celestial movements.
Planar attunement pylons were installed to detect breaches.
During Shar Vahl Reborn, the tower was reinforced with new scrying lenses.
Shadow-Threat Watch established a permanent observation post here.
hooks: A planar breach is detected near the tower’s attunement pylons.
A celestial alignment triggers unexpected arcane resonance.
A scrying lens overloads during observation.
A planar observer reports a disturbance beneath Shar Vahl.
